rv.q: This don’t-miss farce is a complete tour de force for the non-binary writer and actor Cole Escola, who is serving up 80 of the funniest minutes you’ll see in any medium!
Escola is magnificent as Mary, a toothy grimace under a cascade of ringlets that warns all who approach: Watch out, she bites.
Once seen, you won’t soon forget the chaos that happened in front of you.
Escola has written and stars in this short, extremely funny parody, running less than 90 minutes and packed with more goofiness per second than most Broadway shows.
This is not a clever take on Lincoln et al, but a chance for Escola to show off their immense talent to shock and, yes, entertain.
In this master class of millennial mayhem, Escola slyly embraces multiple generations of queer comedy and storytelling.
Cole Escola’s “Oh, Mary!” is the funniest, most outrageous show I’ve seen this season.

cn.t: Cole Escola's uproarious farce about Mary Todd Lincoln earns near-universal acclaim as a comedic tour de force, with critics hailing Escola as a worthy heir to camp legends like Ludlam and Busch in this don't-miss 80-minute gem.

vr.q: Seeing Oh, Mary! at the Lucille Lortel Theater was one of the most enjoyable theater going experiences I've had in awhile.
